chunks: It is narrated from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The place of the grave of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, since the day he was buried in it, is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.

key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, the one whose grave is being honored
key_terms.رَوْضَةٌ: a garden, indicating blessedness and delight
key_terms.رِيَاضِ: gardens, here referring to the gardens of Paradise
key_terms.مَوْضِعُ: the location or place being described

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the grave of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the resting place of Imam al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام has, from the time of his burial, been a garden from the gardens of Paradise. It expresses the sanctity and exalted spiritual rank of his grave and indicates its connection to the reality of Paradise.
